Resolves #21086

Added cursor-based GraphQL pagination (`loadCompleteLinkedPrRefs`) and whole-event target preflighting across both `issue_comment` and `pull_request_target` handlers in `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml`. The workflow walks every `closedByPullRequestsReferences` page (`first: 50`, up to `20` pages), validates `pageInfo` (`hasNextPage`, advancing `endCursor`, non-empty paginated pages) and populated linked-PR node shapes (requiring a valid `OPEN`/`CLOSED`/`MERGED` state, matching `merged` boolean when `includeClosedPrs` is enabled, and an `owner/name` `repository.nameWithOwner` while keeping redacted `null` cross-repo references ignored), loads/validates all affected `removed` and `added` targets before mutating any issue, and completes all final target re-reads and release decisions before posting any availability notice on unmerged closes.

Tested Engine commit containing the repair: `6b2fef0345d03b1868c59d4b2b225c651313905e` (sibling callers under `#21084` / `#20892` can pin the resulting `dev` merge commit). Scoped strictly inside the `script` block (disjoint from `#21092`'s `workflow_call` lines `12–70`) so both merge cleanly in either order.

Evidence: L2 (Node Playwright unit specs executing the live workflow script with real `claimResponse.mjs` and `contributorStanding.mjs` decision modules and mocked GitHub REST/GraphQL I/O) → L2 required (live GitHub GraphQL/REST error modes and multi-page fixtures cannot be forced cleanly against real public issues without side effects).
